# ttdns2.com
> DNS management and related web service tooling for domains, records, and account-based administration.

This site appears to provide domain DNS control, account access, and operational web interfaces rather than a large public documentation portal. The most useful context for language models is the set of primary application entry points and support-related pages available on the domain.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://ttdns2.com/): Primary entry point for the DNS management service.
- [WWW Home](https://www.ttdns2.com/): Alternate host for the main website experience.
- [Login](https://ttdns2.com/login): Account sign-in page for accessing DNS administration features.
- [Register](https://ttdns2.com/register): Account creation page for new users of the service.
- [Forgot Password](https://ttdns2.com/forgot-password): Password recovery flow for existing accounts.
- [Dashboard](https://ttdns2.com/dashboard): Authenticated control panel for managing account resources.

## DNS Management
- [Domains](https://ttdns2.com/domains): Domain listing and management area for user-owned zones.
- [DNS Records](https://ttdns2.com/dns): Interface for viewing and editing DNS record sets.
- [Zone Editor](https://ttdns2.com/zones): Zone-level configuration and record administration tools.
- [Nameservers](https://ttdns2.com/nameservers): Nameserver configuration and delegation management page.
- [Templates](https://ttdns2.com/templates): Reusable DNS configuration templates for faster setup.
- [Import Zones](https://ttdns2.com/import): Zone import workflow for migrating DNS configurations.

## Account and Billing
- [Account Settings](https://ttdns2.com/account): User profile and account configuration controls.
- [Profile](https://ttdns2.com/profile): Personal information and account identity management page.
- [Security](https://ttdns2.com/security): Authentication and account security settings.
- [Billing](https://ttdns2.com/billing): Subscription, invoices, and payment management interface.
- [Plans](https://ttdns2.com/plans): Service plan comparison and upgrade options.
- [API Tokens](https://ttdns2.com/tokens): Token management for authenticated programmatic access.

## Support
- [Support](https://ttdns2.com/support): Main support hub for customer assistance and issue resolution.
- [Contact](https://ttdns2.com/contact): Contact form or contact information for reaching the provider.
- [Help Center](https://ttdns2.com/help): General help resources for common service questions.
- [Status](https://ttdns2.com/status): Service health and operational status information.
- [FAQ](https://ttdns2.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about service usage and policies.
- [Abuse](https://ttdns2.com/abuse): Reporting page for abuse, misuse, or security concerns.

## Developer and Integration
- [API](https://ttdns2.com/api): Programmatic interface entry point for service integrations.
- [API Documentation](https://ttdns2.com/api/docs): Reference documentation for API endpoints and usage.
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://ttdns2.com/api/openapi): Machine-readable API schema for client generation.
- [Webhooks](https://ttdns2.com/webhooks): Event delivery configuration for external integrations.
- [CLI](https://ttdns2.com/cli): Command-line tooling information for managing DNS resources.
- [SDKs](https://ttdns2.com/sdk): Software development kits for supported programming languages.

## Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://ttdns2.com/terms): Legal terms governing use of the DNS management service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ttdns2.com/privacy): Data handling, privacy practices, and user rights information.
- [Cookie Policy](https://ttdns2.com/cookies): Cookie usage and consent-related policy details.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://ttdns2.com/aup): Rules and restrictions for proper service usage.
- [Data Processing](https://ttdns2.com/dpa): Data processing terms for regulated or business customers.
- [Security Policy](https://ttdns2.com/security-policy): Public-facing security commitments and disclosure guidance.
